messages.author: fdaa54d30ab7b913
messages.subject: Problems when using 2 aesthetics
parts:
Dear list members,

I am trying to overlay 2 shapefiles, using geom_tile for one of them and using geom_path for the other one (I want overlay only the lines):

> p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=s1,y=s2, fill = riq)) +
+   geom_tile() + xlab("Longitud") + ylab("Latitud") + scale_fill_gradient(name = 'Riqueza', low="yellow", high="red", breaks = c(1200, 1300, 1400, 1500, 1600)) +
+ geom_rect(aes(xmin = 560000, xmax = 570000, ymin = 971000, ymax = 972000), colour = "black", fill = "black") +
+   geom_rect(aes(xmin = 570000, xmax = 580000, ymin = 971000, ymax = 972000), colour = "black", fill = "white") +
+   geom_text(aes(560000, 974000, label="0"), size = 5) +
+   geom_text(aes(570000, 974000, label = "10"), size = 5) +
+   geom_text(aes(580000, 974000, label = "20 km"), size = 5) +
+   geom_polygon(aes(x = c(617000, 620000, 623000), y = c(1037000, 1043000, 1037000)), fill = "black") +
+   geom_text(aes(620000, 1045000, label = "N"), size = 8)
> p
> p + geom_path(data=aii.df,aes(x = long, y = lat, group=group, colour = DESCRIBE)) +
+   scale_color_manual(name = "Área \nde \nInluencia", values = c("black", "green", "blue"), breaks = c("AII", "AID", "APPHED"), labels = c("AII", "AID", "AP"))
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'riq' not found

But I got an error asking me for something related to the first aesthetics.
Do you know why?
 I was doing the same thing before and was working ok, now I got an error.

Best,

Manuel

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Problems when using 2 aesthetics
parts:
riq is in your ggplot call in the first instance for fill. ggplot is assuming that for any other calls for that plot that the fill for every layer is riq. 

My suggestion would be to take the df, aes(x=s1,y=s2, fill = riq) out of the ggplot() and put it into the geom_tile() 

I would try it, but you didn't supply a working example.

B
